nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: Unless you woke up early on purpose, try to see if there's something that woke up you unintentionally: close the bedroom door or wear earplugs to minimize noises. Lower your window blinds to shut out excessive light.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Slow down and reserve some time for resting today. Be kind to yourself. You deserve some pampering today.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: It might be a good idea to rest or exercise only very lightly today.
